entities.name: Signing of the Guildpact
entities.description: Event that marked the start of Zal Concordant time reckoning in Ravnica.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Ancient living document signed with blood and magic by each of the paruns.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane on which the Guildpact was signed.

entities.name: Cisarzim
entities.description: Led one side in a long war on Ravnica.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros parun who led a side in the war and was the Guildpact's second signatory.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Author of the first draft of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Paruns
entities.description: Founders of the ten Ravnican guilds and signatories of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild whose Jelenn Column complex preserves the first draft.

events.summary: After a long war led by Cisarzim and Razia, the Guildpact is created, dividing duties across the guilds.
events.quote: The Guildpact was created on the plane of Ravnica after a long war

events.summary: The paruns sign the Guildpact in blood and magic; Razia is second and Svogthir third.
events.quote: Its second signatory was the Boros parun
